result.exact_expression: Gram(0,a)=Gram(0,-a); same signed state at theta=pi/2 and 5*pi/2
result.scope: Gram fields lose signed payload and full amplitudes recur at different occurrences. A declared atomic state-and-occurrence-bound Ready-to-Held transition ensures at-most-once, while native authority and first-event liveness remain open.
